blocks.html:
This method updates a tax rate. It sends a request to the
[Update Tax Rate](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#tax-rates\_posttaxratesid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the tax rate to update.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the tax rate to update.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the tax rate.

children.name: rate
children.description: The percentage rate of the tax rate.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the tax rate.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules of the tax rate.

children.name: reference
children.description: The name of the table that the rule references.

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the record in the table that the rule references.

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether the tax rate is the default tax rate in its tax region.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description: Whether the tax rate is combinable with other tax rates.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the tax rate.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the tax rate.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.
